data.title: 伊内丝 · 暮色礁石暗角处的冷眼旁观
data.action: 高高立在背光的尖锐海角黑礁石上，单手按着被海风剧烈吹翻的黑袍衣摆，红紫双眸冷冷俯视潮汐交汇
data.location: 外海暗流涌动的高耸黑色海蚀礁石群
data.lighting: 残阳沉没前的最后一道冷紫与深金晚霞，把尖锐礁石与高挑身形拉成长长的锋利阴影
data.mood: 冷峻警觉、锋芒内敛中透着对同伴无可奈何的默契守护
data.description: 海潮在黑礁岩底部狂暴地撕扯翻滚。伊内丝单脚踩在最险峻的岩脊上，黑色的轻纱长袍在狂风中猎猎作响，勾勒出如同暗夜猎豹般毫无防备死角的高挑体态。她微微眯起深红双眸，冷哼了一声，目光从远方浅滩嬉闹的某个白发萨卡兹身上移开，投向身侧走上来的你——「那两个蠢货在浅滩玩得连影子都散了。……海浪掩盖不了水下佣兵的呼吸声，这片暗礁由我看着。你既然跟上来了，就待在我影子覆盖的范围里，别乱动。」
data.promptProse: Ines stands atop a wave-lashed black coastal reef at dusk, wearing an obsidian-black high-leg bikini with dark violet trim and crossing underbust cords beneath an open sheer black beach robe. Holding one fluttering edge of the robe against the gale, she looks down with a guarded smirk as sunset lavender and gold cut sharp shadows across the rocks.
data.animaCaption: Braced on a jagged black reef rock in a strappy black high-leg bikini with one hand pinning down her wind-whipped sheer robe, she looks down toward the viewer with a cool smirk. Fading purple-and-gold dusk light edges the foaming tide below.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an obsidian-black and dark-violet high-leg strappy bikini with crossing underbust cords beneath an open, billowing sheer black beach robe.
